parameters.description:
Relay a push notification through your own Pushed account by posting a native Pushed payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

`pushed-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `pushed` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Pushed URL from your stored secrets and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters.
